metadata.description: Nohjen's marketplace of Claude Code plugins: skills, agents, commands, and hooks.

plugins.name: feature-flow
plugins.description: An end-to-end feature workflow as a single plugin: brainstorm options on a page you answer in place, write a medium-weight spec reviewed on a page of key points, pictures and question cards, audit umbrellas for coherence, implement the spec (in one session, or with a team of agents) while a read-only spec-verifier agent checks each phase with proof and a report page shows what shipped, then document it — plus a read-only bug investigation that finds the root cause before offering fixes. Six sibling skills (feature-brainstorm, feature-spec, feature-spec-audit, feature-implement, doc-generator, bug-investigate) that share conventions and reference assets.
